title: classified.subject_cards
description: Keyed batch of SHORT listing cards — what a conversation header, a search hit or any other 'this is the thing we are talking about' surface shows. Answers {"cards": {key: {listing_id, title, price, currency, location_label, published_at, image, status, moderation_status, state, owner_id, url, meta_status, meta_reason}}}. `state` is `available` / `unavailable` (paused, sold, expired, blocked) / `gone` (deleted): a key with no listing is ANSWERED as gone rather than omitted, because the caller is rendering a conversation that still exists. `image` carries the CDN render metadata a UI needs to reserve its box (aspect, preview_b64, variants) — the same contract stapel-chat uses for an attachment. This is the function a subject-aware stapel-chat names as its card_function.

keys.description: Listing primary keys, as strings or integers.
